items.title: Netflix’s CSO quits for new storytelling role
items.summary: Netflix Chief Sustainability Officer Emma Stewart is leaving the company to join the leadership team at Climate Spring, a social enterprise focused on changing how climate change is represented in film, TV and popular culture.

items.title: Sustainability pays a credibility tax. Some of it is self-imposed
items.summary: Sustainability investments often fail to get funding, even when there’s no overt pushback. Many common habits of sustainability professionals make the “credibility hole” deeper.

items.title: Tesla sets net-zero target for first time
items.summary: Tesla has pledged to reach net zero by 2040, the first time the world’s most valuable automaker has made a time-bound, company-wide emissions commitment.

items.title: Amazon cloud customers can now see their water withdrawal data
items.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has updated its environmental reporting dashboard to provide customers with annual data about water withdrawals attributed to their cloud computing activities.

items.title: Salesforce expands disclosures about AI environmental impact
items.summary: Software firm Salesforce has added metrics about energy consumption and carbon emissions to the model cards it publishes for several of its widely used artificial intelligence models.

items.title: Octopus and Santander launch ‘first-of-its-kind’ mortgage for Zero Bills homes
items.summary: The new mortgage, designed specifically for Octopus Zero Bills homes, aims to make buying future-ready, lower-carbon houses more accessible.

items.title: How are EU regulations changing the risk calculus for Brazilian commodity buyers?
items.summary: New EU laws are raising the legal stakes for companies sourcing cattle products from Brazil.

items.title: June heatwave cost UK economy over £1bn, study finds
items.summary: Last month's scorching temperatures cost the UK £1.15bn in lost productivity, a study has found, with the heatwave also having cost Europe billions in lost farming revenue.

items.title: Inside the Duchy of Cornwall’s people-first plan for net-zero
items.summary: For nearly 700 years, the Duchy of Cornwall has shaped landscapes, communities and livelihoods across England and Wales.
